candidate: H41 exact-budget role-conditioned 73-stage full-coverage Givens task-atom transport
purpose: Test whether same-role depth transfer needs learned channel mixing rather than H40's nontransferable coordinate polarity, while preserving the exact one-percent state ceiling.

task_atom.formula: D_n = NS5(gradient of fixed task loss with respect to W_n at W0)
task_atom.initialization: all role angles zero, giving exact identity

fit.target: six-node leading PC of the centered registered 239-state trajectory
fit.normalization: unit Frobenius norm independently for every task atom and PC part; normalize prediction only in the cosine objective
fit.algorithm: 64 deterministic full-batch Adam iterations maximizing mean smooth absolute cosine within each fitted role/fold
fit.leave_one_out: fit the other two nodes of the same role only; opposite role forbidden
fit.node_coefficients: post-fit optimal signed scalar; charged but cosine gates are scale invariant

systems_preflight.preflight_scope: both role fit-all fits plus one held-out fold per role

routing_after_pass: Run one identical-state remaining-PC, chronological-late, and disjoint-stream transfer audit before any LM training.
routing_after_failure: Close the exact role-conditioned orthogonal task-atom family and do theory on one causally distinct identifiable carrier with non-orthogonal or nonlinear freedom.
forbidden_followups: stage, prompt, permutation-seed, iteration, learning-rate, role, or target sweep
claiming a no-go for role-conditioned non-orthogonal or nonlinear carriers
